summary: Managed HTTP to an enrolled node whose agent has a node key: 2.10.0 and 2.10.1 agents refused every signed managed request as a replay (NODE_AUTH_REPLAY), which blocked agent upgrades and other managed mutations of those nodes and left their leases unknown. The agent now authenticates a request once, and the server reaches 2.10.0 and 2.10.1 agents with a key without upgrading them first (shared secret on that route only, never in enforce mode). The agent's hermes-cli health check uses the Hermes discovery cache instead of a 2.5-second hermes --version. No migrations and no new settings. Upgrade the server first.
